set.body: From codec slice-1 review (codec-review, 2026-08-28): core/address.scala:82-85 uses Character.digit so %２F parses; :101 turns %FF into U+FFFD. Make parse reject non-ASCII hex digits and malformed UTF-8 with typed errors; add AddressGens coverage for supplementary-plane chars (AddressGens.scala:17 anyPart never produces 4-byte UTF-8). Gate: core + laws + codec JVM/JS/Native green; AddressableLaws unchanged.
set.title: core: Address.parse accepts non-ASCII Unicode digits in %-escapes (Character.digit) and maps invalid UTF-8 (%FF) to U+FFFD — reject at parse, not only via codec's fixed-point guard
